$description: SOLAR PaginationItem: public API, platform states, slots and style recipe in token names. Generated by @bwp-web/codegen from docs/solar-web. Do not edit; decisions go in spec/overlay/, and the ones applied are listed under overlay.

gap.reason: Same value, governed token: a gap Figma leaves unbound at 0 is the none of its family, and SOLAR picks the family by direction, as its own bound gaps do: a horizontal auto layout's gap is an inset, a vertical one's a stack (the Foundations agent reference and the Spatial chapter). Decided once here, as the paddings are.

paddingTop.reason: Same value, governed token: a padding Figma leaves unbound at 0 is inset.none, SOLAR's token for no inset. It is the one answer in every component, so it is decided once here and raised with SOLAR once, as a whole, not per component.

docs.description: Numeric page selector used inside Pagination. 10 variants: selected (false/true) × state (default, hover, pressed, focus, disabled). Selected renders in action/tertiary/bg/active treatment; unselected is plain text in action/tertiary chrome. Hit area is 44×44 minimum (WCAG 2.5.5). Use inside the Pagination assembly — not standalone.

rules.reason:
One page of a Pagination, its description says: a button that goes to its page, the current one selected (`aria-current="page"`). MUI's ButtonBase on the web, for its keyboard focus (focus-visible) and press; its number drawn with the shared layer helpers. Bespoke in Flutter, drawn and pressable. At 24 × 24,
  its target is its own box: the items sit 4px apart, where 44 × 44 targets would cover each
  other (owner decision 2026-09-24, as Tree Item's actions), which meets WCAG 2.2's 24px
  minimum; the design review asks SOLAR for room.
